SHARE

MUSCAT, OCT 27

The United Architects of the Philippines (UAP) Oman, a professional body of the working architects, has successfully celebrated it’s a decade long professional excellence under the auspices of Noralyn Jubaira Baja, Philippine Ambassador to the Sultanate of Oman, together with representatives of the Philippine Embassy, Migrant Workers Office (MWO), and Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA).

The event themed ‘Movers of Progress 2.0 – A Decade Strong: Expanding Networks, Strengthening Partnerships, EmpoweringProgress,’ marked a significant milestone in the chapter's ten-year journey as well as the 3rd General Membership Meeting for Fiscal Year 2026–2027.

Representatives from the Oman Society of Architects highlighted the growing professional relationship between Filipino architects and Oman's architectural community and shared professional expertise with the Filipino architects, distinguished guests, fellow professionals, and industry partners for an evening of recognition, professional fellowship, and meaningful engagement.

A presentation on the history and development of the UAP Oman Chapter was delivered by former Chapter President Ar Darwin Pascua and reflected on the chapter's establishment in 2016, its accomplishments over the past decade, and the contributions of its members to the architectural profession in Oman. Following, special messages from former Chapter Presidents and UAP National leadership emphasised the importance of continuity, professional unity, and the shared commitment to advancing the architectural profession.
